# Aesop

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Skincare storefront: one warm ink on a cream ground, a single tannin-amber accent, Suisse Intl sentence-case, 1px keylines (many drawn as box-shadows), 40px fields, 48px bars, 400px side rails.

Captured 2026-11-10, signed out (every captured surface is public); US storefront Sites-aesop-us-Site, OneTrust consent SDK network-blocked. Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Aesop, the skincare house, for building storefront, campaign and editorial surfaces in the style of the real thing. Captured from the US storefront (`aesop.com`, Salesforce B2C Commerce `Sites-aesop-us-Site`) on 2026-11-21, signed out, in headed Chrome (Playwright) at a measured 1440×900 and 390×844. Headless Chromium is stopped by Cloudflare on every document, so the shots use `channel: chrome`. The control map is [site-tree.md](site-tree.md).

The 2026-11-21 pass covers the home page and its search disclosure, email sign-up dialog, account sign-in dialog (login wall, not submitted), cart drawer and Skin Care flyout, Shop all with the Filter-by rail, Skin Care, Gifts, Library, Experience, Our story, Contact us, Gift Finder, The Aesop Gift Gathering, the site map, one PDP (The Aesop Valise, APB399) with an open accordion, the store locator (map tiles painted out), the empty cart, the Demandware sign-in page (login wall, not submitted), the styled error pages at `/account` and `/account/login`, and the phone menu.

The reason Aesop is worth a capture: a single warm ink (#333333) does text, keylines and button fills on a cream ground (#fffef2); one tannin amber (#945c26) is the only accent (badges, promos, inline links); Suisse Intl in two cuts sets everything in sentence case; rules are 1px hairlines, many drawn as box-shadows; corners are square; the footer inverts to cream-on-ink.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- The capture is the US storefront. A region dialog may name another country before it is hidden. Other regional assortments were not visited.
- Store-locator map tiles are painted out. Street names and nearby-store lists are not in the package. Geolocate was not granted.
- The signup dialog's empty phone field is painted out. Nothing was typed into it.
- The Account dialog and `Login-Show` are login walls. Nothing was typed or submitted. Facebook and Google were not clicked.
- https://www.aesop.com/account/login returns the styled error page (HTTP 404), not a form.
- Headless Chromium does not load this storefront. Values read on 2026-11-10 came from a headless session that Cloudflare no longer allows. The 2026-11-21 screenshots are the live record. Token numbers were not re-read in this pass where the 2026-11-10 computed styles still name them.
- The ADD TO CART bar was caught mid-hydration labelled "Loading …" on the 2026-11-10 measurement. The 2026-11-21 phone PDP shows the resting "Add to cart" label.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do set it in ink on cream.** One warm ink #333333 on #fffef2 carries text, keylines and the dark fills ([header](components/crops/header-default.png), [footer](components/crops/footer-default.png)).
- **Do spend the one amber on badges and links.** #945c26 marks New addition / Beloved formulation tiles, promos and inline links — nothing else ([tile-badge](components/crops/tile-badge-default.png)).
- **Do keep labels sentence case in Suisse Intl.** Nav, buttons and badges run the medium cut; body and prices the regular — never uppercase ([nav-link](components/crops/nav-link-default.png), [product-card-name](components/crops/product-card-name-default.png)).
- **Do draw edges as 1px keylines, often as shadows.** Hairlines are 1px — many computed as `rgb(51,51,51) 0 0 0 1px` box-shadow rather than border ([newsletter-field](components/crops/newsletter-field-default.png), [variant-box](components/crops/variant-box-default.png)).
- **Do give controls one geometry.** Fields are 40px tall; buttons and CTA cards 48px with 24/13 padding; drawers 400-405px ([search-field](components/crops/search-field-default.png), [add-to-cart](components/crops/add-to-cart-default.png), [cart-panel](components/crops/cart-panel-default.png)).
- **Don't round, shadow or ease the controls.** Corners stay 0px, elevation is absent, and most state changes are instant ([hero-cta](components/crops/hero-cta-hover.png)).
- **Don't expect a focus ring.** None paints on the measured controls — keyboard focus lands with at most a colour shift ([footer-link](components/crops/footer-link-focus-visible.png)).
